description: Shared docs: Open a doc or paste by id: an unlisted one, or one you may read. The current text is in the first answer only, screened for prompt injection by default. Free, no key needed, within a daily limit; unlisted docs and pastes only, by id. Signed as your identity when this connection has one, within its daily limit.

max_cost.description: optional: your ceiling in credit; a higher price is refused, nothing spent. Default: the quote

request_id.description: optional retry key: a retry from your network returns the first answer, never charged twice (another network: 409). Left out, call.request_id returns one; yours: random, new per call

screen.description: screen the text for prompt injection (default true; its writer pays what it cost, once per version)
